pages.text: A solar panel goes on a rack. Build the rack from steel and set it down facing the way you want, then mount a photovoltaic panel on it: a P and an N semiconductor from The Factory Must Grow under glass, in an aluminium frame.
pages.title: Solar panels

pages.text: Under open sky it feeds the electrical network, 120 volts while the sun is up and up to 200 watts at noon, nothing at night or in shade. Break it and you get the rack and the panel back.
